title: check.py's path budget fits the longest worker worktree name and the sync gate checks every added path's length
goal: S3 gap found by the SP-vayhvwfy review: _tools/check.py:82-83 budgets a tracked path against a worktree named agent-ST-xxxxxxxx (17 characters), while Agent-tool isolation worktrees in this clone are agent-<17 hex> (23 characters), so TRACKED_PATH_MAX is 179 where the longer name allows 173 and a 174-179 character path passes check.py but fails a Windows worker worktree; and kg_sync.gate_needs runs check.py only when a kb/, _tools/ or root-level path changed, so a long new path under another directory (.claude-plugin/) is never checked. The operator confirmed ST-icgtdnuf g1 (80-prefix-limit-179) before this was known: the limit is put to the operator again with the longer name.
